description: Hand the editor a picture from a file on the designer's computer — a survey map, a site plan, a dimensioned drawing. Pictures the designer pastes into this chat never reach the editor, so the map tools can't use them: ask where the file is and attach it by its full path. The editor keeps it at full size as the next attached image; the reply shows its copy (view "N"): point at that copy's pixels with zoom_image (a close-up) and set_survey_map (lay it under the garden by matched points). PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 20 MB; a PDF: a page exported as an image first.

label.description: What the picture is, e.g. 'site plan from the developer'

path.description: The file's full path on the designer's computer, e.g. C:/Users/Ania/Documents/plan.png

name: attach_image
